'''Lana Dobreed''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who had dreams of opening a shop in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], though his [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] led him to provide transportation services to pay for the activity.<ref name="CCG" />
